## Context

Direct Anthropic fallback was approved for rebar model classes, but the class chains were not
configured because the direct Sonnet capability row was still fail-closed. Investigation proved the
existing conservative whole-chain capability intersection is intentional. A live direct Anthropic
Sonnet call then proved native structured output both with and without thinking, so the standard
class can use a capability-symmetric direct fallback without redesigning fallback orchestration.

## Implemented design

- `frontier`: Bedrock Opus primary, direct Anthropic Opus fallback.
- `standard`: Bedrock Sonnet primary, direct Anthropic Sonnet fallback.
- `trivial`: Bedrock Haiku only until direct Haiku capability parity is measured.
- The exact direct Sonnet model records the measured native-output and thinking capability.
- The existing whole-chain capability intersection remains unchanged. Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic
  chains conservatively disable prompt caching because their cache styles differ.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A valid non-interactive Anthropic credential was proven by successful live direct-Sonnet
      native-output calls without reading or printing the secret. [operator-attested]
- [x] The standard-class capability asymmetry is resolved with measured exact-ID metadata rather
      than by weakening the conservative chain intersection.
- [x] `rebar.toml` configures the approved direct-Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard.
- [x] Provider parity tests replace the obsolete direct-Sonnet asymmetry assertion with symmetric
      native-output coverage and pass.
- [x] Project-default tests pin both fallback IDs to the Anthropic provider overlay.
- [x] Trivial remains single-arm because direct Haiku parity has not been measured.
- [x] The change passed Gerrit `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and merged as change 1594.

## Verification evidence

- Focused fallback/config/parity tests: 58 passed.
- `make lint`: passed.
- `make typecheck`: passed.
- Full non-integration/non-external suite: 11,822 passed, 49 skipped, 0 failed.
